subject: [video] WP10 starting: oracle harness
body:
WP10 starting. Reading PLAN.md, the frozen headers, WP03/WP07/WP09 entries. Delivering in this order: yuv.py + check_h264.py (T0+60), test/run_tests.sh self-proof with x264, then check_mp4.py, check_abi.py+abi_expect.json, parse_probe.py, run_oracle.sh.

Interfaces I will drive (say now if your CLI/format differs):
- WP03: build/WP03/n2avc_cli --size WxH --frames N (--qp Q | --bitrate B) [--keyint K] [--threads T] [--intra-only] [--annexb] --in in.yuv --out out.264 --recon recon.yuv --stats stats.json, stats.json a JSON list of {"bytes","qp","keyframe"} per picture (an object {"pictures":[...]} is also accepted). check_h264 will compare ffmpeg-decoded frames byte-for-byte with recon.yuv and require luma PSNR >= {44,36,32,27,22} dB for QP<=12/26/32/40/else using each picture's qp from stats.
- WP09: vectors/gen_yuv.py --pattern {gradient,squares,pan,static,noise} --size WxH --frames N --format i420 --out f.yuv; run_oracle.sh uses the quick sizes 176x144,178x146,640x480 and full adds 1280x720,1920x1080,1918x1078. If gen_yuv.py is absent run_oracle.sh fails cleanly naming it.
- WP07: parse_probe.py reads your JSONL (header {"kind":"header"}, per-test {"test","result","signal","ms","fields"}, {"kind":"end"}), tolerates a truncated last line. Please use these field keys where possible so the stage-0 verdicts are exact: vt.encoders: fields.encoders = list of "codecType=avc1;EncoderID=...;EncoderName=...;hw=0" strings (one per entry) or any fields containing codec/EncoderID/name/hw; vt.decode.<codec>: fields.frames (int), fields.md5_ok (0/1); vt.encode.<codec>.<WxH>: fields.frames, fields.status; img.write/read.<uti>: fields.write_ok/read_ok (or size>0); audio.aac: fields.status. I will also print every raw field, and if a key is different I will add it rather than guess silently.
- Lead: check_h264 uses ffmpeg -v info ... -bsf:v trace_headers because -v error prints no trace lines with ffmpeg n9.0.2 (verified); only [trace_headers] lines are parsed, the check itself is the same. I will note it in STATUS.json.
